title: Team Janus – CanSat Competition
story: Team Janus represents SEDS BPHC in the annual international CanSat Competition, where students design miniature satellites that simulate real aerospace missions. In 2021, the team developed dual auto-rotating maple-seed style science payloads and made it to the CDR stage despite the challenges posed by the COVID pandemic. In 2022, they designed a payload connected by a 10-meter tether, requiring stable 45-degree southward camera orientation throughout descent.

questions.question: What unique payload did Janus build for the 2021 mission?
questions.hint: Inspired by how seeds naturally spin as they fall.

questions.question: What major challenge did the 2021 team face?
questions.hint: They still reached the CDR stage despite global restrictions.
